prompt: A teenage boy in pajamas standing alone on a quiet suburban street at 2am under a streetlamp, leaning close to read the license plate of a parked car — while his translucent spirit-double floats high above the rooftops against the starry night, looking down at the same car.

A hospital waiting room seen from a spirit's view: a huddled family in chairs, a woman pulling a single pale-blue tissue from her purse, mid-conversation and teary — the ghostly translucent figure of a woman in a hospital gown watching them unseen from the corner.

A man's translucent spirit drifting through a friend's living room; through the window behind him, a backyard with ornate Moroccan-style tents being planned — the friend sits at a table sketching the party layout, unaware he is being watched.

A hospital room: a uniformed officer standing at a bedside slowly closing a small notebook, his eyes brimming with tears, while the woman in the bed with a neck brace looks up at him calmly, knowingly.

A hospital corridor at night seen from a floating spirit's view: a middle-aged man sneaking a candy bar from a glowing vending machine, while through a doorway behind him a couple kneels in desperate prayer.

Viewed from directly above an open ambulance at night: paramedics performing CPR on a young man, one paramedic's shirt marked by a tiny bright red pin that glints upward — the young man's spirit hovering just above, noticing it.

A young man and his sister sitting close on a couch; he speaks softly while a delicate ribbon of light flows from her forehead to his — her face frozen in shock, hand over mouth, as he repeats her own thoughts back to her.

In a luminous otherworldly space, a woman turns toward a presence forming beside her out of swirling wisps of cigarette smoke and perfume — the wisps half-shaping a smiling older sister she barely knew.

A woman's spirit standing in a warm heavenly light, looking down through the light at her own body seated in a hospital chair far below — a small glowing point at the body's abdomen that the doctor beside her cannot see.
A hospital corridor: a man's translucent spirit gliding past a passing nurse, her whispered words rendered as a thin luminous thread drifting from her lips to his ear as their paths cross.
A cozy living room: a father walking on a treadmill chatting with a toddler in diapers playing nearby — while a woman's translucent spirit watches them fondly from up near the ceiling corner.
A filmmaker seated at a desk in a dark room lit only by his monitor, surrounded by a wall covered in dozens of small glowing portrait frames — each frame a different face, all quietly looking at him.
